sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets ships and encodes PC6/PC7 applicability, the vertical-sided-bow or inclusive 0–10 DEG angle alternatives, required design-force method, and explicit non-applicability evidence with valid SHACL structure, datatypes, and units.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Prevent accidental passes from conflicting multivalued facts. Require exactly one nltl:polarClass (add sh:maxCount 1), otherwise a ship carrying both PC1–PC5 and PC6/PC7 can satisfy the non-applicable sh:or branch without the required PC6/PC7 bow-selection evidence. Also constrain nltl:verticalSidedBowForm and nltl:bowDesignForceMethod to at most one value so contradictory booleans or an additional non-(iv) method cannot pass merely because one acceptable value exists. Retain the conditional PC6/PC7 applicability and the inclusive 0–10 DEG envelope.

Repair the PC6/PC7 applicability logic: a normalFrameAngle value between 0 and 10 DEG is itself included in the vertical-sided-bow condition, so it must trigger bowDesignForceMethod "I2.3.2.1 (iv)" even if verticalSidedBowForm is false or absent. The current false branch accidentally passes a PC6/PC7 ship with a qualifying angle and no required method, while the true branch unnecessarily requires both the Boolean and angle evidence. Encode the vertical-sided condition so verticalSidedBowForm=true or qualifying normal-frame-angle evidence activates the method requirement, and ensure missing branch-selection evidence cannot pass.

Candidate faithfully targets ships and encodes PC6/PC7 applicability, the vertical-sided-bow or inclusive 0–10 DEG angle alternatives, required design-force method, and explicit non-applicability evidence with valid SHACL structure, datatypes, and units.
